title: 华为Mate 8月销破百万台，CES抢滩海外市场 [Huawei Mate 8 sales and overseas launch at CES]

passages.locator: Opening paragraph on 9 December sales; paragraph comparing Chinese and overseas configurations
passages.note: Huawei states that the Mate 8 went on sale in China on 9 December 2015. Huawei identifies the Kirin 950 on 16nm FinFET+ in the Chinese and overseas configurations.
